summary: Typeset and visually inspect the full-wrap cover
instructions: Run bookfactory cover build padel-addicts-guide. Inspect output/cover-build/cover-wrap.png (full wrap) and cover-thumb.png (Amazon-size front thumbnail). If anything needs changing, edit cover/cover.json - not the PDF - and build again. Once it looks right, run bookfactory cover build padel-addicts-guide --submit to register it as a versioned draft; it only submits if the cover checks pass.
